title: fix(objectql): a cleared optional multi-value field stores null, so a second record cleared on a unique one is no longer refused 409
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ87zVbP3nBfJDyeiMeBBoJsW)_
Fixes #29343

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:可选的多值字段(multiselect、tags、checkboxes,及 `multiple: true` 的 lookup / user / select / file / image)写入 `[]` 或 `''` 时,写入口统一存成 `null`;级联 `set_null` 删光最后一个成员时也读回 `null`。
- 为什么改:`[]` 被存成 JSON 文本 `'[]'`,唯一约束下第二条清空的记录被拒 409;按裁决 A(记录 6591577985)执行,spec 半边已由 #29763 落地。
- 风险与回滚:读形状变化,原来读回 `[]` 的可选多值字段改读 `null`;`$empty` 两者都算空,只按 `Array.isArray` 判断的读者要处理 `null`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts`(新 reach `'emptyList'`)、`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts` 的 `normalizeBlankTypedRow`、`packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-multivalue-probe.test.ts`(钉子从 `[]` 改为 `null`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-data-multi-value-blank.test.ts`,预期 15/15 通过(main 上 12 条红)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Write door** (cherry-picked from the built branch `claude/project-thread-tfknlu`, `eb81c1f6` → `ce827aa2`, `55aa2656` → `f147106e`): `blankAsNullColumns` in `@objectstack/core` gains the reach `'emptyList'` for every optional column on the `$empty` table's `multi_value` row, and `blankStorageForm` stores `[]`, or exactly `''`, there as `null`. The objectql door's row walk (`normalizeBlankTypedRow`) now hands an empty list to the rule. Required columns, whitespace and non-empty lists are untouched; the `$empty` table is unchanged.
- **Pins moved to `null`** (`f0afc329`), the cascade `set_null` repair that empties an optional set now reads back `null` through the door:
  - `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-multivalue-probe.test.ts` (docblock, the "LAST member" pin, the "every dependent row" pin);
  - `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-user-field.test.ts` (multi-valued `set_null`);
  - `packages/runtime/src/cascade-delete-multivalue-lookup-real-driver.integration.test.ts` (real SQLite driver, read back from the database);
  - `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/delete-record-predicate-walk-batched.integration.test.ts` (batched predicate walk).
- **Prose**: the "`[]`, never `null`" sentence is replaced for optional columns in `packages/core/src/utils/required-emptiness.ts`, the two `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` blocks (`set_null` doc and the member-removal comment) and the `record-validator.test.ts` docblock. The `required` half (an empty list fails `required`) is kept everywhere.
- **Docs**: six hand-written pages now say an emptied optional multi-value field is stored as `null`, that a row stored earlier can still hold `[]`, and that `is_empty` matches both: `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx`, `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx`. No release notes, no CHANGELOG, no `content/docs/references/`.
- **Readonly columns** (`b702c0f1`, round-2 ruling A, record 6598733139): the `'emptyList'` arm never reaches a `readonly: true` column. A readonly column is platform-stamped and never cleared by a writer, so `sys_activity.changed_fields` keeps `[]` for "stamped, nothing changed" (ADR-0139 E6). `BlankAsNullFieldDef` gains `readonly?: boolean`. The `'blank'` and `'empty'` arms are unchanged. One unit pin covers it, with controls.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29343-multi-value-blank-null.md` (`@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/core`, patch): names ruling A, the Clause-② widening and the read change (`[]` → `null` for optional multi-value, including the cascade repair).

## Why

Ruling A on this card (record 6591577985): an optional multi-value column written `[]` or `''` stores `null`, unique-covered or not; `required` still means a non-empty list; the `$empty` table is unchanged. The spec half (`FieldSchema`'s `multiple` and `required` doc blocks) landed in #29763 for #29652. Stored `'[]'` / `'""'` rows are cleaned by #29653, not here.

## Tests

All readings below are at head `8e4ba024` (the three commits plus a merge of `origin/main` `b62463f1`), except the red-first reading, which is at `origin/main` `97c2982c`. Head `60dc73ff` adds one comment-only commit: the `blankSingleValueColumns` docblock in `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.ts` (the contract review's should-fix, 6597445147). At `60dc73ff`, the cli unit test for the command passes 46/46, its integration test passes 6/6, and the cli typecheck exits 0. Head `b702c0f1` (after merging `origin/main` `55dca466` as `b784ff6a`) adds the readonly carve-out. At `b702c0f1` the following pass:
- cli `activity-changed-fields.integration` 4/4 and `blank-single-values` 6/6;
- plugin-audit `activity-changed-fields-backfill.integration` 5/5;
- REST 34/34;
- core 2937/2937 and its typecheck;
- objectql 10777/10777;
- service-automation 4/4;
- the runtime real-driver suite (7, 1 skipped).

With the carve-out removed, the new pin and exactly the CI reds go red (cli cases 2–4, plugin-audit case 2). They pass again once it is restored.

- Red first, at `origin/main` `97c2982c` with its own build: `rest-data-multi-value-blank.test.ts` 12 failed / 3 passed (15). Every per-type unique case (multiselect, multi-value lookup, tags, unique-index member) answered 409 on the second `[]` or `''`.
- Green after the change: that file plus `rest-data-single-value-blank` and `rest-data-optional-unique-blank` 34/34; objectql targeted files 191/191; runtime real-driver file 7 passed, 1 skipped (the Postgres cell, needs `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`); service-automation batched walk 4/4.
- Whole packages: `@objectstack/objectql` test 545 files, 10767/10767 (before and after merging `main`); `@objectstack/core` test 132 files, 2936/2936; metadata-protocol `seed-loader` files 26, 257/257; cli `blank-single-values.integration.test.ts` 6/6 (integration project). Typecheck exit 0 for core, objectql, runtime, service-automation.
- Ablation, one-shot: `blankStorageForm`'s `'emptyList'` arm replaced to return the value unchanged (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`), core rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` exit 0. Result: objectql 5 failed / 38 passed (both probe pins, the user-field pin, two door unit pins); REST 12 failed / 3 passed. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0, the same files 43/43 and 15/15. A first attempt carried its marker in a comment, which the build strips; its preflight answered exit 1, so that run is void and was repeated with a code marker.

## Acceptance notes

- Read change, stated in the changeset: an optional multi-value field cleared from now on reads `null`, not `[]`, including the `set_null` cascade repair that removes the last member. `$empty: true` matches both. A reader that branches on `Array.isArray` alone has to read `null` as empty too.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.ts` (docblock near line 109) still says the `blankAsNullColumns` map holds three arms; it now holds four. That file is outside this claim's surface; the behaviour is pinned (`blank-single-values.integration.test.ts` keeps its column set). Noted for the seat.
- `test:repo` (vitest `repo` project) was not run locally; it belongs to CI (`Test Core`).

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `8e4ba024`: 101 families derived. All 101 run locally; every one exit 0. At `60dc73ff`, the derivation is the same 101 families. The 46 families on the changed path re-ran, all exit 0, and `--ran` reports 101 run with 0 NOT-MEASURED. At `b702c0f1`: 101 derived, 101 run, all exit 0, and `--ran` exits 0.
- Seven first answered exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, built output missing: `check:skill-examples`, `check:dts-closure` (exit 1, read while a sibling build rewrote `driver-sql/dist`), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`) or could not reach a pinned fixture commit on the shallow clone (`check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`). After building the client SDK and the packages closure, and fetching that commit, each re-ran exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 101 derived, 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
- CI runs the full farm (`pnpm lint`, `test:repo`, dogfood is not owed: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind (`'emptyList'`).
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. The changeset carries both declaration lines, as does this body.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
